name: DataXAPI: competitor accounts' new posts to Slack or Feishu

parameters.content:
## Competitor new posts to a chat webhook
Every 6 hours, reads the latest page of each account listed in **Accounts to watch** and posts the ones not seen before to a Slack incoming webhook.

For a Feishu (Lark) bot, change the body to `{"msg_type": "text", "content": {"text": ...}}`.

**Cost:** 1 DataXAPI call per account per run; with 3 accounts that is 12 calls a day. Prices differ by platform: see each endpoint page at https://dataxapi.com/apis/
